messages:
ana-ux: Pinging team for a quick micro-review of the roles table help texts + aria hints I added. Goal: reduce support tickets where admins misinterpret "Grant access" vs "Assign role". zack-eng: Thanks Ana. Quick infra note: keep help text client-side only, but canonical strings should live in i18n keys so we don't diverge. Also prefer short labels in compact mode. ana-ux: (typo: ana) Ack. Updated i18n keys: roles.help.assign = \"Assign role to selected members. This sets permissions associated with the role but does not change SSO settings.\" roles.help.grant = \"Grant access creates a temporary invitation link that may bypass SSO if allowed by org policy.\" marta-pm: mmm, wording suggestion: avoid the word \"bypass\" since it's scary. Maybe: \"...may allow non-SSO sign-in if org policy permits.\" olivia-security: We should be explicit when bypass is allowed: show a red pill with text "Non-SSO allowed" and require a hover/exposed tooltip listing compliance risk. Also every time a grant occurs we must generate audit events with prior_value and new_value. zack-eng: On aria: proposed aria-describedby on the primary actions pointing to a visually-hidden element with the help text. Example:
Assign role to selected members. Does not affect SSO.
a11y-bot: Auto-check: [x] sr-only exists, [ ] focus order verified, [x] i18n keys present. Recommend testing with NVDA/VoiceOver. ana-ux: Thanks. Another micro-issue: the action menu currently lists \"Grant access\" above \"Assign role\" which leads people to click the wrong one. Reordering to surface \"Assign role\" first reduced mistakes in the prototype. marta-pm: Good catch. Also add a small inline hint when selecting an admin-level role: \"Admin roles require confirmation.\" with a link to docs. \zolivia-security: For audit nav, clicking on the role should build a query: role_id=xyz AND events IN (role_assignment, grant_access) AND from=last_90_days. Provide a copyable permalink and throttle heavy queries. zack-eng: We'll implement server-side guard: if the query spans > 1 year or matches > 10k events, return a summary and ask user to narrow timeframe. UI will show a banner and a \"Load full results\" button. a11y-bot: Micro-accessibility note: the confirmation modal's checkbox must be programmatically required (aria-required) and keyboard-focusable before the primary Confirm button is enabled. ana-ux: Final question: compact vs expanded help placement. Compact: small info icon that opens a bordered tooltip panel; Expanded: help lines visible below action buttons. Which for rollout? marta-pm: Rollout plan: show full help in expanded mode and info icons in compact behind a feature flag. Track support-rate reductions. \zolivia-security: Also require that changes to SSO policy surface the delta in the modal: show before/after SSO state and count of affected users. zack-eng: Will add telemetry events: roles_assign_clicked, grant_access_clicked, roles_help_opened. a11y-bot: Final checklist: [x] sr-only labels added, [x] aria-describedby implemented, [ ] keyboard flow test scheduled. ana-ux: Thanks all 64b I'll update the i18n keys and comps, add the confirmation modal copy, and create a short QA checklist for A11y testing. Will loop back after the first internal canary.
